stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 19 hours and pipe B can fill it in 5 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/19$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/5$. Combined rate $= 1/19 + 1/5 = 0.2526$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/19+1/5} = 3.96$ hours.
